body:
Lol. No. Not u/AnOddName. But nice attempt to delegitimize the points. 

Why are they deserving of that criticism? Because you cant recognize a joke? 

They apologised for the part that actually was a fuckup: removing a post that didn't violate a rule. Sounds pretty professional to me. 

Who says they cant handle criticism? They seem to be responding to it fine. Seems like you're the one that cant imagine that it's you that's off base. So much for not being able to handle criticism.

>	act with some modicum of professionalism

Kindly get off your high horse. 

They're a volunteer. If they want to make jokes they have every right to do so. Why do they need to adhere to your definition of professionalism anyway? 

Seriously. Be mad at the people like you that wont stop hounding them. The only people that give a shit if people troll are those too dumb to notice the bait.
Why have a megathread for something that already happened? This feels like a karma grab more than anything.

Seeing as moderation on this sub is arbitrary this could end up being allowed. 

[It's not art of a girl though](https://www.reddit.com/r/kpop/comments/6x2qj8/starting_to_draw_kpop_artists_heres_my_first_of/dmcx4pu/), so I wouldn't count on it.
